plain: A disorderly mob; the lowest class

webster.text: A tumultuous crowd of vulgar, noisy people; the mob; a confused disorderly crowd.

example.quote: To make amends for their own incapacity, the gallery was filled with a rabble, who shouted their applause, and these heroes of aristocracy were not ashamed, though modesty is their national virtue, to vindicate such a violation of decency: Means not less criminal, but not so flagrantly indecent, have been frequently mentioned among us to secure a majority.
example.cite: Letters of Agrippa I-XI, Massachusetts Gazette, Nov. 1787-Jan. 1788
